_comment: Lab-group profiles for the Biology Department. Each profile scopes the web UI sidebar to the tracks that group uses. To add a lab: copy a block, give it a unique id, a name/blurb, and list its track ids. Optional 'image' = a logo: a filename placed in upstream/static/ (png/jpg/svg) or a full https URL. Valid track ids: qc, genomics, rnaseq, atacseq, chipseq, methylation, proteomics, download. Use ["*"] for every track. This is navigation only — it does not restrict the CLI or lock anyone out.
